item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Round-trip space emoji and keep import sheets readable
  • Add web extension support
  • Add Chrome and Arc importers
  • Keep invalid remote sort keys from crashing
  • Add sidebar drag and drop
  • Add CloudKit sync layer behind a flag
  • Release v0.1.0
  • Restore back/forward history once the web view is on screen
  • Add app icon with light/dark option
  • Render each snapshot layer once
  • Add tinted toolbar, clean URL display and copy link
  • Add address bar position setting and fix collapsed sidebar
  • Honor MYBROWSER_APPEARANCE and even out space icons
  • Move toolbar above content and fix sidebar selection
  • Add two-finger swipe to switch spaces
